notes.title: Launcher Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215442/aaf87612d523f710ce9bb8787a55a28cb5e69c95.png[/img]

[b][h2]Welcome to the new update! [/h2][/b]
We have added a special [b]FoxSox Games Launcher[/b] to our games. 
The launcher automatically starts only when you begin the game and closes immediately after the game starts. Its main purpose is to inform you about the latest updates in our game offerings. This is an optional feature, so you can choose to skip it and go directly to the game by selecting the appropriate option when launching the game.

Additionally, we've implemented a few minor improvements that enhance performance and fix some minor bugs in the game.

notes.title: Goat's Tale Adventure | Announcement
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=t8Mno-4yvoM;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763050/Goats_Tale_Adventure/]Goat's Tale Adventure[/url]

Welcome to the [b]Goat's Tale Adventure[/b]! It's an engaging precision platformer whose predecessors gained recognition from over [b]several thousand players on the Steam[/b]. Now, we invite you to an entirely new experience with our new heroine taking the lead!

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[b]Enhanced Physics and New Code[/b]

Taking into account feedback from the previous two parts, we decided to thoroughly rebuild the game's physics to make it more precise. Now, the heroine moves with significantly improved agility, and the gameplay dynamics have gained a new dimension thanks to the game code written from scratch.

[b]New Mechanics[/b]

Changing the main character (we'll see you soon, courier), we focused on introducing unique abilities that highlight her uniqueness. Our heroine, Bouba, has mastered the art of controlling water. Now, every waterfall becomes an elevator for her, allowing her to overcome obstacles and reach even greater heights.

[b]World Exploration[/b]

In [b]Goat's Tale Adventure[/b], every level holds treasures to collect, and before them stand powerful monsters ready to be defeated by our heroine.

[h2]Goat's Tale Adventure offers:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]A challenge for the most demanding players.[/b]
[*] [b]A completely new adventure led by the heroine.[/b]
[*] [b]Even more captivating gameplay.[/b]
[*] [b]Wonderful music.[/b]
[*] [b]New, innovative mechanics tailored to the heroine's abilities.[/b]
[*] [b]Beautiful, pixel art graphics.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215442/00d7456a061a777150ceebcd764b3b9f9e82da79.jpg[/img]

Welcome to another update! Although Goat's Tale has not yet passed verification, we would like to inform you that we have taken the first steps, so now you can comfortably enjoy our game on the Steam Deck! There are still some minor improvements ahead, but at this moment, you can enjoy our production!

[h2][b]Update 2.0[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the game's resolution for the Steam Deck.
[*] Added information about controller support.
[*] Added buttons that link to our other games.
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[*] Full DX11 game support has been implemented to enhance game performance (native DX9 version has been removed)
[/list]

[i]In the near future, we will also work on fixing some graphical issues that we are aware of and adding full DLC integration for the Steam Deck.[/i]

notes.title: Goat's Tale will leave Early Access on January 17!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215442/5efb03d4b0ff9a9d8916d72d302892da5c1d3315.jpg[/img]

The day has arrived, Goat's Tale is complete and it will be released on January 17th!
We would like to thank everyone for supporting our project. We've made a lot of changes during Early Access. We improved the graphics, controls, mechanics and many more things that you brought to our attention.

Patch 1.0 will be released on January 17th, and with it a very big change.
Goat's Tale will be available [b] for free! [/b] Two maps will be available in the free version, Capra Mountain and Capra Mountain V.II. On the other hand, people who have already purchased the game will get [b] free DLC [/b] under the name [b] Goat's Tale + [/b] in which all maps that were in early access and the multiplayer mode will be available. (The DLC will be available with the game launch and will be the same price as the current Early Access game)
